review.disposition: Nested-float P1 and collapsing-margin P2 were reproduced and fixed. After the targeted confirmation, the primary coordinator closed the resolved-origin wrapper sibling class with the explicitly recorded 54 focused checks and fresh native controls. No third review is claimed.

limits.parallelSubset: Horizontal/top-aligned auto-height, nowrap flex and simple one-auto-row grid items with stable page geometry/body reservations. limits.continuousAndSnapshot: ScreenFullPage remains an explicit single long screenshot. ScreenSnapshotPaged slices a fixed continuous scene without reflow or added table repeats. Clipped glyphs/annotations can cross surfaces; independent PDF readback does not establish exact-once content for that mode.

collapsedBorders.boundary: Pre-existing collapsed-border inset/row sizing remains open. Native sample is the print-CSS DOM cell, not a universal PDF geometry or pixel-equivalence claim.

limits.historicalReports: The retained historical corpus was unavailable. These separately declared synthetic reports do not close its font, grid, SVG, geometry or whole-corpus acceptance.
limits.appearance: Matched print page counts and complete content do not establish pixel equality, general browser conformance or cross-platform appearance.
